```python
# Pydantic models for API
class CustomerData(BaseModel):
    customer_id: str
    age: int
    income: float
    purchase_history: List[Dict]
    browsing_behavior: Dict
    location: str
    registration_date: str

class PurchaseRequest(BaseModel):
    customer_id: str
    product_id: str
    price: float
    category: str
    timestamp: str

class RecommendationRequest(BaseModel):
    customer_id: str
    product_count: int = 10

class SegmentationRequest(BaseModel):
    customer_ids: List[str]

# Metrics
request_counter = Counter("api_requests_total", "Total API requests", ["endpoint"])
response_time = Histogram(
    "api_response_time_seconds", "API response time", ["endpoint"]
)

@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup_event():
    """Initialize models and services on startup."""
    global customer_segmentation, purchase_prediction, recommendation_system, data_processor

    logger.info("Starting E-Commerce Analytics Platform...")

    try:
        # Initialize data processor
        data_processor = DataProcessor(config)

        # Load models
        customer_segmentation = CustomerSegmentationModel(config)
        purchase_prediction = PurchasePredictionModel(config)
        recommendation_system = RecommendationSystem(config)

        # Start background tasks
        start_background_tasks()

        logger.info("Platform started successfully")

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to start platform: {str(e)}")
        raise
```

sections.title: start_background_tasks(), retrain_models(), update_recommendations() …
sections.body:
Start background tasks for model retraining and data processing. Retrain models with new data. Update product recommendations. Process new customer data.

```python
def start_background_tasks():
    """Start background tasks for model retraining and data processing."""

    def run_scheduler():
        schedule.every().day.at("02:00").do(retrain_models)
        schedule.every().hour.do(update_recommendations)
        schedule.every(30).minutes.do(process_new_data)

        while True:
            schedule.run_pending()
            time.sleep(60)

    # Start scheduler in background thread
    scheduler_thread = threading.Thread(target=run_scheduler, daemon=True)
    scheduler_thread.start()

def retrain_models():
    """Retrain models with new data."""
    try:
        logger.info("Starting model retraining...")

        # Retrain customer segmentation
        customer_segmentation.retrain()

        # Retrain purchase prediction
        purchase_prediction.retrain()

        # Update recommendation system
        recommendation_system.update()

        logger.info("Model retraining completed successfully")

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Model retraining failed: {str(e)}")

def update_recommendations():
    """Update product recommendations."""
    try:
        logger.info("Updating recommendations...")
        recommendation_system.update_recommendations()
        logger.info("Recommendations updated successfully")

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Recommendation update failed: {str(e)}")

def process_new_data():
    """Process new customer data."""
    try:
        logger.info("Processing new data...")
        data_processor.process_new_data()
        logger.info("Data processing completed")

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Data processing failed: {str(e)}")
```

Predict purchase probability.

```python
@app.post("/api/v1/purchases/predict")
@response_time.labels(endpoint="purchase_prediction").time()
async def predict_purchase(
    request: PurchaseRequest,
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security),
):
    """Predict purchase probability."""
    request_counter.labels(endpoint="purchase_prediction").inc()

    try:
        # Verify authentication
        if not verify_token(credentials.credentials):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid token")

        # Prepare features
        features = data_processor.prepare_purchase_features(request)

        # Make prediction
        probability = purchase_prediction.predict_proba(features)

        # Log prediction for monitoring
        metrics.log_prediction("purchase", probability, request.customer_id)

        return {
            "customer_id": request.customer_id,
            "product_id": request.product_id,
            "purchase_probability": float(probability),
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        }

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Purchase prediction failed: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
```

```python
@app.get("/api/v1/analytics/dashboard")
async def get_dashboard_data(
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security),
):
    """Get dashboard analytics data."""
    request_counter.labels(endpoint="dashboard").inc()

    try:
        # Verify authentication
        if not verify_token(credentials.credentials):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid token")

        # Get dashboard data
        dashboard_data = {
            "total_customers": data_processor.get_total_customers(),
            "active_customers": data_processor.get_active_customers(),
            "revenue_today": data_processor.get_revenue_today(),
            "top_products": data_processor.get_top_products(),
            "segment_distribution": customer_segmentation.get_segment_distribution(),
            "model_performance": {
                "segmentation_accuracy": customer_segmentation.get_accuracy(),
                "prediction_auc": purchase_prediction.get_auc(),
                "recommendation_precision": recommendation_system.get_precision(),
            },
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        }

        return dashboard_data

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Dashboard data retrieval failed: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
```
